# Codex DeepSeek Switcher

Independent MIT-licensed VS Code extension. Canonical source: https://github.com/dzrdzrdzr/codex-model-switcher
Marketplace ID: dzr.codex-local-model-switcher
Marketplace: https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=dzr.codex-local-model-switcher
Install: code --install-extension dzr.codex-local-model-switcher

Switch between the normal .codex home and a separate .codex-vscode-deepseek home. Targets: local Windows x64 and Linux via VS Code Remote SSH. Requires openai.chatgpt on the same extension host and an initialized config. Not a general-purpose CLI or desktop provider manager.

Commands: Codex Source: Use DeepSeek Direct; Codex Source: Use GPT (OpenAI); Codex Source: Show Current Codex Source Status.

Scope is the OS account/home, not each VS Code window. Shared homes and SSH aliases can share selection. Reload affects new processes; this is not hot switching. Direct configuration uses https://api.deepseek.com/ and wire_api=responses; status does not verify connectivity or billing.

The key is plaintext in the isolated config, not encrypted by masked input. Normal auth.json is not copied; unrelated provider/MCP values may be retained from source config. Switching back does not delete keys or backups. Never request a user's raw configs or keys.

Docs: https://github.com/dzrdzrdzr/codex-model-switcher/blob/main/README.md
中文: https://github.com/dzrdzrdzr/codex-model-switcher/blob/main/docs/README.zh-CN.md
Validation: https://github.com/dzrdzrdzr/codex-model-switcher/blob/main/docs/VALIDATION.md
The _site directory is generated locally; do not infer a live GitHub Pages deployment from source files alone.
